text:
alex: Customer hit a bunch of 500s on /v1/chat and says there is no request token in the console. Any quick checklist to send them?

maria: Ask them for the response headers and a snippet of the SDK logs first. The token we surface is either in the response header `x-rw-request` or as `req_id` in the SDK debug logs.

sam: If they're on mobile, tell them to check SDK verbose logs — on iOS look for `RW_REQ=` lines, Android prints `rw_request=`. Often it gets stripped by mobile proxies though.

alex: Good. Can we give a minimal curl example for them to replay and capture the header?

maria: Yup, send this to reproduce and capture the header:

```
curl -i "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/chat" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

maria: The response headers will include `x-rw-request: <token>` and also `x-rw-region`. Ask them to paste the full response (headers + body).

sam: If customer can’t run curl, ask them to send a HAR from their browser devtools. They should filter network requests to `api.redwood-` and send the HAR. Remind them to redact API keys.

alex: What about console location? Where can they find the token in our dashboard?

maria: In Console -> Requests -> click the request row -> the right panel shows "Debug token" (labelled as Request token). If they click Copy it gives the token we correlate to logs.

sam: Also useful: tell them to include timestamps and the SDK log level if they can. If it's a latency issue, include the client-side timings.

debug-bot: automated-note: If you provide the token, we can pull server-side traces and the routed model variant. Include any customer ID or org id if multi-tenant.

alex: One more thing — some customers see different tokens across retries. Tell them to grab the first token from the initial failed response.

maria: TL;DR to send: 1) raw response headers (or curl output), 2) SDK log snippet containing the request token, 3) HAR (if applicable), 4) timestamp window and any client request id.

sam: I'll draft a quick template we can paste into replies so support reps don't forget redaction steps. :white_check_mark: 

alex: thanks — that should let eng fetch the trace and root cause quickly. :thumbsup:
